# Reply to every customer review in minutes

> Free review response generator. Paste your Google, Yelp or Facebook reviews and get a ready-to-post reply to each one: rating-aware, specific, safe around legal, health-privacy and refund traps, and checked before you post. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
